answer: To enroll, an applicant posts a slashable stake that becomes their on-ledger anchor and is burned if a second persona is proven against the same operator. They then attend a booked slot at a surveyed knoll, where staff weigh a uniquely machined brass token on a sealed load cell and watch them sign a carbon ledger with a registered quill. A camera records nib wear and ink-lot fluorescence under a UV strobe locked to the scale tick. Cloning seats means funding a new anchor, cutting a new token, traveling to the knoll in the window, and faking an unreplicable nib-and-ink pair in front of staff.
